title: Exclusive ghost tour coming to R.E. Olds Transportation Museum
excerpt: The R. E. Olds Transportation Museum is scheduled to host an exclusive ghost tour led by the Southern Michigan Paranormals this Saturday night as part of its How-To Halloween event.
content:
LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) — On Saturday night, the R. E. Olds Transportation Museum will get a bit spooky with the Southern Michigan Paranormals taking over for an exclusive ghost tour.

The paranormal investigative site will actually give the participants access to search in the archives of the museum, which are not usually open. The event caps off a bigger free event this weekend, How-To Halloween, which takes place during the day on Saturday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.

The Southern Michigan Paranormals will lead the event, and to start will be scary storytelling in the boardroom, which is a part of the original building. Then, the group will be led around the dimly lit museum around all the historic artifacts in search of any spirits for the rest of the two-hour long event.

People who have access are welcome to bring their own gear for tracking the supernatural. The director of How-To Halloween, Jerry Jodloski, says that this is a highly unique experience and something that has never been done before at the museum.

"This is our first time for everyone. So, they're going to be investigating along with the public at the same time. So, we have nothing to report yet, and it's nice that the people who are joining us will be part of the first discoveries," says Jodloski. "It's what the city was built on and we're so thrilled to be able to, you know, give people, you know, a chance to see it in a different way."

This event has two different times available, one happening at 6 p.m. and the other at 8:30 p.m. in the evening. Tickets are available for both times and cost a little over $30 per person.
